sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 800. Success value 100. 2x magic damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies Absolute (increases the maximum number of Attack Skills that can activate by 1) for 70 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Mastery (increases the maximum number of Defense Skills that can activate by 1) for 70 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Dawn for 120 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; recovers 10 Cost when using an Ability. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; applies Dual Attack; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
-Target: all allies. Applies Overcast for 60 seconds ([Special] increases max HP by 100%; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; increases all elemental defense by 60; recovers 50 Cost. After the effect ends, Time Extend activates and extends the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to yourself by 60 seconds for one time only.).
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 35000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 80% for 120 seconds.
Light and Time Defense from Unison Damage +600
